name: Name
allSpace: The space, all current and future projects in this space

formLabelTips.name: Provide a token name
formLabelTips.scopes: With this token, you will be able to:
formLabelTips.access: This token can access the following projects and spaces. You can only grant access to projects and spaces you have access to.

new.title: Personal access tokens are required to use the Teable API.
new.description: This token grants access to data in the selected spaces and projects, as well as API endpoints that are not tied to a space or project. Use it only for your own development, and be careful when sharing it with third-party services.

success.title: Token successfully generated
success.description: Make sure to copy your token. It will never be displayed again.

refresh.title: Regenerate personal access token
refresh.description: Submitting this form will generate a new token. Be aware that any scripts or applications using this token will need to be updated

list.description: Personal access tokens are required to use the Teable API. Please refer to the help document for more information.

deleteConfirm.title: Are you sure you want to delete this token?
deleteConfirm.description: Any applications or scripts using this token will no longer be able to access the Teable API. You cannot undo this action.

noAccessConfirm.title: Are you sure you want to continue?
noAccessConfirm.description: This token will not be able to access any data in any project.

permission.title: Permissions
permission.tip: A token can never do more than your own role allows in a space.

dataEditor.name: Edit data
dataEditor.description: Create, update and delete records, but not the table structure

builder.name: Build
builder.description: Build tables, fields, automations and apps; cannot manage members or spaces

fullAccess.name: Full access
fullAccess.description: Everything you can do in the space, including inviting members and deleting spaces

data.name: Data
data.description: Records, export, SQL query, record history

permission.customHint: Customized, no longer matches a preset.
permission.needSchemaRead: Accessing data needs at least table|read and field|read
